purpose: Canonical full-replay test of textureless stationary signed-prime/risk continuity using coherent displacement instead of raw NVOFA motion magnitude.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 20 inherited mode 18 current-surface continuity and added a textureless stationary fallback for prime/risk only; displayed history and moving/camera paths still used conservative raw-disocclusion semantics.
interpretation: Mode 20 proved the textureless stationary fallback is useful: moving-flash reduction rose to 0.959 and the perceptual floor to 0.414, leaving only luminance_quarter@7.5Hz in the WCAG sweep. It is rejected because extreme-pan MAE rose to 0.06669. The leak is architectural: stationary sequence logic reused a camera-motion corroboration that is intentionally zeroed during active protection, and its textureless state-disocclusion fallback did not return fully to raw semantics when camera motion was present.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
